columns.name: merchant_tier
columns.reason: Standing merchant classification held on the acquirer's account record before the transaction.

columns.name: wallet_provider
columns.reason: Wallet used to present the credential is known at authorization.

columns.name: terminal_class
columns.reason: Attribute of the accepting terminal, fixed before the transaction is run.

columns.name: issuer_country
columns.reason: Derived from the card BIN and known the moment the card is presented.

columns.name: onboarding_vintage
columns.reason: Merchant onboarding cohort is historical and immutable at transaction time.

columns.name: cross_border_flag
columns.reason: Computed at authorization from issuer versus acquirer country.

columns.name: chargeback_fee_usd
columns.reason: A per-case fee only assessed once a chargeback has actually been filed.

columns.name: installment_flag
columns.reason: Installment indicator is part of the authorization request itself.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.reason: Transaction currency is set when the payment is initiated.

columns.name: network_token_flag
columns.reason: Whether a network token was used is determined during authorization.

columns.name: recurring_flag
columns.reason: Recurring indicator is carried in the authorization message.

columns.name: days_to_dispute_close
columns.reason: Requires a dispute to have been opened and then closed, both after the target event.

columns.name: chargeback_office
columns.reason: An office is assigned only when a chargeback case is created, so it postdates the target.

columns.name: prior_disputes_12mo
columns.reason: Trailing count over the preceding twelve months, computable from history at scoring time.

columns.name: mid_group
columns.reason: Merchant ID grouping is static reference data on the merchant record.

columns.name: tid_group
columns.reason: Terminal ID grouping is static reference data on the terminal record.

columns.name: batch_close_hour
columns.reason: Settlement batch timing is fixed within a day of the transaction, long before any dispute, though it depends on the exact scoring point.

columns.name: cvv_result_code
columns.reason: Returned by the issuer in the authorization response.

columns.name: processor_id
columns.reason: The processor routing the transaction is known when it is submitted.

columns.name: account_tenure_days
columns.reason: Cardholder account age as of the transaction date is computable at that moment.

columns.name: avg_ticket_usd
columns.reason: Trailing merchant average ticket derived from prior activity.

columns.name: issuer_rule_device_novel
columns.reason: Issuer risk rule output evaluated in real time during authorization.

columns.name: channel_code
columns.reason: Acceptance channel is part of the transaction as submitted.

columns.name: reserve_class
columns.reason: Standing merchant funding/reserve category on file, though such classes can be revised later.

columns.name: decline_reason_prior
columns.reason: Explicitly refers to a prior attempt, so it is already recorded before this transaction.

columns.name: settlement_batch
columns.reason: Batch assignment is finalized at settlement, well before a dispute window opens, but it depends on the exact scoring point.

columns.name: mcc_code
columns.reason: Merchant category code is standing merchant reference data.

columns.name: issuer_rule_velocity_score
columns.reason: Velocity score is computed from prior activity at authorization time.

columns.name: card_product
columns.reason: Product type is derived from the BIN and known at authorization.

columns.name: statement_cycle
columns.reason: Billing cycle is an account attribute determined by the account and transaction date.

columns.name: merchant_region
columns.reason: Static geographic attribute of the merchant record.

columns.name: auth_amount_usd
columns.reason: The authorized amount is set in the authorization request itself.

columns.name: merchant_fraud_rate_90d
columns.reason: Trailing ninety-day merchant rate read as a lookback snapshot at scoring time.

columns.name: avs_result_code
columns.reason: Address verification result is returned in the authorization response.

columns.name: representment_rounds
columns.reason: Representment only exists after a chargeback is filed and contested.

columns.name: reward_tier
columns.reason: Card reward tier is an attribute of the cardholder product held before the transaction.

columns.name: funding_delay_band
columns.reason: Reads as a banded merchant funding term set alongside the reserve class rather than a post-dispute hold.

columns.name: fx_markup_band
columns.reason: FX markup pricing is determined when the transaction is converted, not by the dispute.

columns.name: acquirer_bin
columns.reason: Acquiring BIN is fixed routing reference data for the merchant.

columns.name: entry_mode
columns.reason: POS entry mode is captured in the authorization message.

columns.name: issuer_rule_geo_mismatch
columns.reason: Geo mismatch rule fires during authorization from data present at that time.

columns.name: case_queue
columns.reason: A case queue is populated only once a dispute case exists, which is after the target.

columns.name: three_ds_version
columns.reason: The 3-D Secure version used is recorded during authentication at transaction time.

columns.name: risk_model_ver
columns.reason: Version of the risk model in force when the transaction was scored, known at that moment.
